findings_qualitative.value: First extragalactic detection of 13C18O; no obvious gradients in ratios within ~300 pc

claims.hypothesis: Do resolved optically thin tracers give lower isotope ratios than single-dish values?
claims.experiment: Fit LTE spectra at 14 positions with C4H deblending
claims.finding: Ratios are about a factor of two below those generally adopted for galaxy nuclei

evidence.quote: Derived isotopic ratios $\rm ^{12}C/^{13}C$$\sim21\pm6$, $\rm ^{16}O/^{18}O$$\sim130\pm40$, and $\rm ^{18}O/^{17}O$$\sim4.5\pm0.8$ differ from the generally adopted values

claims.hypothesis: Is 18O enhanced relative to the Galactic center?
claims.experiment: Compare ratios with Galactic center values
claims.result: Lower 16O/18O and higher 18O/17O than Galactic center

evidence.quote: Measured isotopic ratios suggest an enhancement of $^{18}$O as compared to our Galactic center

claims.hypothesis: Are there multiple gas components with different processing?
claims.experiment: Compare interferometric ratios with single-dish ratios and missing flux
claims.finding: Highly processed compact gas plus less processed extended gas

evidence.quote: evidence of a multicomponent scenario with molecular gas highly processed in the central region of NGC 253

why_this_method.value: Optically thin isotopologues minimize optical depth, excitation and photodissociation biases

evidence.quote: one would rather choose the observation of optically thin isotopologues such as $\rm C^{18}O$  and $\rm ^{13}C^{18}O$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CH3OCH3 rejected as contaminant because other of its transitions are not detected

evidence.quote: which implies that $\rm CH_3OCH_3$ does not contribute significantly to the observed profile

limitations_admitted.value: Fractionation not constrained; source size and Tex assumed; 13CO moderately optically thick; missing short spacings

evidence.quote: Since we are not able to provide sensible constraints on fractionation issues in the framework of this paper

referee_caveats_inferred: Single transition per isotopologue forces fixed Tex=15 K and 3'' source size
Column density ratios may not equal isotopic ratios if fractionation or selective photodissociation are present
The multicomponent claim relies on the single-dish flux scaling and positional differences
C4H deblending for faint components is highly uncertain
